notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with power one or greater.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature with power one or greater, adding one mana of any color.
Kresh triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
